data.summary: Topical antifungals · Unsaturated fatty acid antifungal (with zinc undecylenate)
data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Topical antifungals_

**Class:** Unsaturated fatty acid antifungal (with zinc undecylenate)

## Mechanism of action
- Fungistatic — disrupts fungal membranes and morphogenesis (yeast-to-hyphae)

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Tinea pedis, tinea cruris (powders/creams), diaper candidiasis (weak)

## Dose & formulations
- Twice daily for 2–4 weeks

## Adverse effects
- Irritation, rancid odour

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity

## Pregnancy & lactation
Safe.

## Viva points
- Fatty acid antifungal; weak, mainly OTC foot powders

_Sources: Khopkar ch.19 (Traditional antifungal remedies). Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
